source: Aspöck, Brinkmann, Ackermann, Weinzierl, Vorländer: GRAS – Ground Truth for Room Acoustical Simulation, TU Berlin DepositOnce, 3_surface_descriptions.zip, https://depositonce.tu-berlin.de/items/19a794ad-0359-410e-bc9c-ad96df1434d5 ; CSV line 3 = scattering; material descr files: 'Estimated data for absorption and scattering coefficients'; documentation §2.3: 'Scattering coefficients were estimated according to structural dimensions of the materials.'
note: GRAS RockFon Sonar G (absorption measured by GRAS; scattering line supplied without separate provenance → treat as estimate).
usage: Per hit: E_spec *= (1 - s_b); E_scatter = 1 - prod(1 - s_b). Specular tap amplitude sqrt(prod(1-s)); scattered share -> short Lambert-envelope velvet cluster, feed-forward on the early tap only. Muted face contributes neither absorption nor scattering.
